Static/shared library audit follow-up
=====================================

Current work added:

* Linker option probes for GNU/LLVM-style unresolved-symbol and whole-archive
  validation flags.  Unsupported platforms skip these checks rather than
  receiving untested flags.
* --no-undefined style link validation for shared BRL-CAD libraries when the
  platform linker supports it.
* Static archive link-test executables generated by BRLCAD_ADDLIB.  These tests
  force each static archive's members onto a link line with the library's
  declared PUBLIC, PRIVATE, and INTERFACE dependencies so missing dependency
  declarations are caught by building the check target.
* Static BRL-CAD targets no longer advertise DLL import definitions to
  consumers; those definitions are appropriate for shared-library imports, not
  static archives.

Remaining production-grade static library work:

1. Audit every BRLCAD_ADDLIB call that still relies on the legacy libslist
   argument.  Split each dependency into PUBLIC, PRIVATE, or INTERFACE based on
   whether public installed headers expose the dependency's headers or link
   requirements.  Until this is done, many targets conservatively expose too
   much through INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES.

2. Audit bundled and system third-party package targets for static variants.
   BRLCAD_STATIC_VARIANT currently maps BRL-CAD targets to their static twins,
   but many external package variables still resolve to shared libraries in the
   quick-iterate configuration.  A fully static SDK needs each Find*.cmake or
   config-mode dependency to expose a usable static imported target and its own
   transitive dependencies.

3. Extend install-tree validation.  The in-tree static link tests verify build
   targets, but installed BRLCADStaticTargets.cmake should also be checked by a
   small external CMake consumer using BRLCAD_USE_STATIC_LIBS=ON and linking at
   least libbu, libbn, libbg, librt, libged, and BRLCAD::brlcad.

4. Add platform-specific equivalents for the current GNU/LLVM linker checks.
   MSVC needs /WHOLEARCHIVE and unresolved-symbol behavior validated with its
   linker flag probes before equivalent tests are enabled there.

5. Review intentional plugin or application callback symbols.  Any library that
   deliberately references symbols supplied by a host application needs those
   symbols formalized as a documented interface dependency or excluded from the
   whole-archive validation with a target-specific rationale.

6. Re-run a full BUILD_STATIC_LIBS=ON configuration with Tcl, JPEG, and other
   optional image/GUI dependencies present.  The quick-iterate environment used
   for this audit configured far enough to inspect core targets, but stopped on
   missing Tcl/JPEG development inputs before a complete all-target static audit
   build could be completed.
